text:
Anna (PM): quick sync — we need to set a lightweight post-launch cadence for ChatAssist v1.0. goal: clear rules for bugs vs enhancements and a schedule for minor releases.
Simon: +1. want a simple rubric so eng can triage without waiting for PM.
Raj: suggested tiers: P0 (prod-hotfix), P1 (high customer impact, next minor), P2 (nice-to-have, backlog).
Olivia: agree. also propose a "fast-fix" label for <=3d work we can push in out-of-cycle minor releases.
Maria: can we tie release cadence to metrics? e.g., if >0.5% user error rate or >3 customer reports in 48h -> trigger minor.
Anna (PM): yes. metrics threshold sounds good. add latency regression >15% as trigger too.
Simon: for enhancements: categorize as quick wins (<=5 dev-days), medium (sprint), long (multi-sprint). quick wins get >50% chance to be in next minor.
Raj: infra note — we need a staging canary flag so we can roll fixes to 10% of traffic before full minor. deploy-bot: Canary created: channel=staging, percent=10. id=canary-17612
Olivia: can we formalize acceptance criteria in the ticket template? add fields: "rollout-trigger", "metric-thresholds", "canary-plan", "rollback-criteria".
Maria: I'll update the template quick. pulling an example:```
{
  "rollout_trigger": "error_rate>0.5% or customer_reports>=3",
  "canary_percent": "10",
  "rollback": "error_rate_increase or fail_rate>baseline"
}```
Anna (PM): nice. next: backlog grooming — we'll tag candidate enhancements as POSTLAUNCH_M1 or POSTLAUNCH_M2 and review weekly.
Simon: propose a weekly 30m groom on Tuesdays 9:30 PST. fast-fix tickets get priority block on agenda.
Raj: owners: Raj -> infra hotfixes, Simon -> product infra improvements, Olivia -> UX/usability fixes, Maria -> acceptance/tests.
Anna (PM): ok owners noted. timeline: this week we ship hotfix branch for memory leak (P0), scope: trace sampling change + small GC tweak. Raj will estimate EOD.
Raj: estimated 1.5 days. will open PR by tomorrow.
Olivia: I'll add regression test and a short postmortem checklist.
Simon: reminder: document rollback steps in the PR description, tag with "postlaunch-hotfix".
Anna (PM): action items:
- Raj: PR for memory fix (ETA 24h)
- Olivia: QA regression + smoke (ETA 48h)
- Maria: update ticket template + label creation (ETA EOD)
- Simon: calendar invite for weekly groom (sent)
Everyone: flag anything that meets metric triggers right away.
Maria: done — template updated and labels created. :tada:
Anna (PM): perfect. we'll reconvene after Raj's PR lands. thanks all :thumbsup:
